title: ReseedInternalBalances: no farmers/balances length check, OOB revert DoS
description: setInternalBalances iterates `i` over `internalBalances.farmers.length` and reads `internalBalances.balances[i]` without first requiring `farmers.length == balances.length`. If the supplied `balances` array is shorter than `farmers`, `balances[i]` reverts with an array-out-of-bounds panic, aborting the internal-balance reseed step (and thus the whole migration upgrade). If `balances` is longer, trailing entries are silently ignored but the subsequent `require(totalInternalBalance == internalBalances.totalInternalBalance)` guard catches the mismatch and reverts cleanly. This is DT-011. The defect only triggers on malformed upgrade input supplied by the privileged migration caller (no permissionless attacker), so impact is bounded to a recoverable migration-step revert with a non-descriptive panic.
impact: A malformed (shorter-balances) input array reverts the internal-balance reseed step of the migration with an opaque OOB panic rather than a clear precondition error. Bounded to the privileged upgrade path and recoverable by resubmitting correct data; the totalInternalBalance guard already catches most mismatches. Low (best-practice / robustness of a one-shot privileged init).

ice_chain.corrupted_state: n/a (revert) or silently truncated credits caught by the totalInternalBalance guard
ice_chain.impact: Internal-balance reseed step reverts on malformed input, aborting that migration step until correct data is supplied.
ice_chain.consumer_function: LibBalance internal-balance consumers depend on a completed reseed
ice_chain.exploit_path: init with farmers.length > balances.length -> balances[i] OOB -> Panic revert
